# Bundled PDF fonts

V0.3.9 bundles only open-source font assets for local PDF generation.

- `NotoSansSinhala-Regular.ttf` — Noto Sans Sinhala, SIL OFL 1.1
- `NotoSansTamil-Regular.ttf` — Noto Sans Tamil, SIL OFL 1.1
- `NotoSansMono-Regular.ttf` — Noto Sans Mono, SIL OFL 1.1
- `NotoSansSymbols2-Regular.ttf` — Noto Sans Symbols 2, SIL OFL 1.1
- `NotoSansKR-Regular.woff2` — compact Noto Sans KR subset, SIL OFL 1.1
- `NotoEmoji-Regular.woff2` — Noto Emoji, SIL OFL 1.1

The fonts are embedded in generated PDFs only as needed by the PDF engine. They are not uploaded or fetched remotely at runtime.
